seed_rule.children: graph, coefficient, location, innovation = SeedSequence(master).spawn(4), each generate_state(1)[0]

generator.graph: spadag.sim.reversal_dgp.draw_partitioned_graph with cohort_config(p): patch sizes (2,3,4) p=(.4,.4,.2), coverage [.08,.36], indegree<=2, target_mean_edges=.65p
generator.scale: one global multiplier; population child-triangle SNR median 1 with quadrature escalation 5/9, 9/13, 13/17
generator.observations: iid Uniform [0,1]^2; raw baseline 0; raw innovation sd 1; per-column standardization ddof 0
generator.n_pairing: p=50: generated at n=1000, n=500 and n=250 are re-standardized prefixes; p=25/75 generated at n=500

hashes.gamma_sha256: SHA256 of gamma.npy (int64) in the cohort bundle; reproduced by the generator
hashes.bundle_checksums_sha256: SHA256 of the cohort's bundle_checksums.json; includes K-L and metadata files that are not reproduced
